description: Notes in markdown, visualised as anything
config.title: NoteThink
config.trace.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the extension.
config.settings.view.type.description: Default view type. The user default applies in every workspace unless that workspace overrides it.
config.settings.card.type.description: Default card type - how a note is drawn inside whichever view is showing. 'auto' follows each file's nt_card linetag, then the view's own default.
config.settings.view.userTypes.descripti: View types you saved yourself, each a named set of overrides on a built-in view. Written by "Save as a new view type" in the view settings tab rather than edited by hand.
config.settings.view.generic.showLineNum: Show line numbers in NoteThink views.
config.settings.view.generic.showLinetag: Show linetag chips inline in story headlines.
config.settings.view.generic.scrollNoteI: Scroll the focused note into view when the editor caret or a click moves focus.
config.settings.view.generic.autoExpandF: Expand the focused note past its clip height so its whole body is readable.
config.settings.view.generic.watchUnopen: Watch the active viewed file for on-disk changes when it isn't open in a text editor (refreshes the viewer when another tool edits it).
config.settings.view.generic.openNewEdit: When you click a note and no editor is open beside the NoteThink view, open the note in a new editor group. When off, clicking a note never spawns a new editor group.
config.settings.view.specific.grouped.gr: Attribute the Line view groups its lanes by, or 'auto' to follow each file's nt_group_by linetag.
config.settings.view.specific.line.orien: Lay the Line view's lanes out as columns side by side, or as stacked rows.
config.settings.view.specific.kanban.gro: Attribute the Kanban view groups its lanes by, kept separate from the Line view's own choice. 'auto' follows each file's nt_group_by linetag.
config.settings.view.specific.kanban.car: Target card ratio on a Kanban board, as the card's height divided by its width. The column width is derived from it: NoteThink measures how much text a typical card holds and picks the width that lands the cards near this ratio, so a wider panel shows more lanes rather than wider ones.
config.settings.view.specific.kanban.col: Group order: the order a Kanban board draws its lanes in (raw status slugs like 'code-review' or 'done'). Lanes not in the list appear after, sorted alphabetically with 'untagged' last.
config.settings.view.specific.kanban.ani: Animate passive kanban transitions (cards moving as another tool or the editor changes their status) with a brief slide.
config.settings.files.includeFilter.desc: Glob of files to include in folder mode.
config.settings.files.excludeFilter.desc: Glob of files to exclude in folder mode.
config.settings.files.maxNotesPerFile.de: Cap on stories taken from each source file when merging the folder aggregate.
